run_train_loop: run the training loop for a latent diffusion model using an OmegaConf YAML config file
train_model_from_config: train a latent diffusion model by loading model, optimizer, and loss from a config file
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a saved checkpoint file with model and optimizer state
save_training_checkpoint: save persistent checkpoints of the model and optimizer at configured iteration intervals
evaluate_model_with_summary: evaluate the model on validation data and generate summary visuals at configured intervals
